description: Wall time of three operations for 1 000 188 atoms of fcc Cu (a = 3.61 A, random displacements of 0.05 A, cutoff 3 A, 12 neighbors per atom).
machine: Apple M4 Pro with 14 cores; pyscal 4, OVITO and freud used all 14 threads, pyscal 3.3 has no threading and ran on one. On battery power (macOS low power mode); all codes were run one after the other in one session.
timing: Minimum over repeated calls adding up to at least 0.3 s (one call above 5 s). Converting ASE Atoms into each code's own container is not timed.
